name: ipscout
description: Ping hosts, sweep a subnet for reachability, measure round-trip time and packet loss, run a traceroute and list local interfaces from Python or the shell, as an ordinary user with no root or Administrator rights and without shelling out to the ping binary. Ships the python-network-probe skill: install, the library API, the CLI with its JSON envelope, the raise-on-setup-problems error contract, and the measured platform limits.
